correctness.rationale: Root preference count induces a unique unfilled initial peripheral prefix; clique blocks then independently contribute compositions with u(1+u)^(t-1) as their lucky-car enumerator. Geometric summation gives formula. Adjacent block swap identity follows from polynomial cancellation and proves coefficientwise extremal ordering. Reconstructed boundary cases r=1 and m_i=1, and independently verified direct parking vs two symbolic methods on 127 graphs, 35 local cases, and 12 swaps.
